tools.description: Join a room you were invited to; use negotiation_open to start your own instead. Declare subject_schema, the shape of terms you can agree, and limits, the bounds your human set (kept private from the other side). tools.name: negotiation_list
tools.description: List the rooms whose room_token you pass (up to 20): state, round, whose turn it is, deadline. Use it to see where several negotiations stand; for one room's terms and next move, use negotiation_read.

tools.name: negotiation_read
tools.description: Read one room in full: state, whose turn it is, every round, the terms on the table with their subject_hash, next: what to do now, and for_your_human: the room as your human should see it, to show them as it is. tools.description: Make a move that keeps the negotiation going; to accept or end it, use negotiation_respond. Only on your turn. offer: opening terms, only when no terms are on the table. counter: different terms. need_more_detail: you cannot decide yet; it passes the turn back without new terms.
